Role Overview
Cognizant is seeking an experienced Knowledge Graph Data Engineer to build and operate the connectivity, profiling, and graph/search foundation that powers enterprise ontology and knowledge management platforms.
In this role, you will be responsible for transforming raw operational and master data sources into clean, lineage-tracked, governed, and queryable knowledge assets. You will design and support data connectivity, metadata management, graph platforms, ingestion frameworks, and search capabilities that enable scalable knowledge discovery and enterprise intelligence solutions.
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), data engineering, metadata management, graph technologies, data lineage, and scalable ingestion architectures.
Work Model
This position is fully remote within the United States , providing flexibility while collaborating with globally distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Occasional travel may be required for client workshops, planning sessions, architecture reviews, and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Data Connectivity & Integration
+ Design, develop, and maintain connectivity solutions for enterprise data sources.
+ Build adapters and integration frameworks supporting:
+ BigQuery
+ Cloud SQL
+ REST APIs
+ Apigee
+ Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
+ Pub/Sub
+ Establish scalable and reliable ingestion patterns for operational, transactional, and master data systems.
+ Support API-based integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms.
Data Profiling & Metadata Management
+ Profile enterprise data to assess:
+ Data Quality
+ Completeness
+ Statistical Patterns
+ Dependencies
+ Data Relationships
+ Source System Characteristics
+ Develop data discovery frameworks that support ontology and semantic model development.
+ Build metadata management processes supporting data governance, traceability, and analytics.
+ Surface data quality issues and metadata findings to architecture and business teams.
Knowledge Graph & Search Platform Engineering
+ Design and operate the enterprise Knowledge Core supporting graph-based data exploration and search.
+ Implement graph and knowledge management platforms utilizing:
+ Spanner Graph
+ Neo4j
+ Amazon Neptune
+ TigerGraph
+ RDF/SPARQL Technologies
+ Equivalent Graph Platforms
+ Support graph data modeling, relationship management, and semantic search capabilities.
+ Enable enterprise-scale graph analytics and knowledge discovery use cases.
Batch & Streaming Data Engineering
+ Build and maintain batch and real-time data pipelines that continuously synchronize source data with graph and catalog platforms.
+ Design ingestion architectures utilizing:
+ Dataflow
+ Apache Beam
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Event-Driven Architectures
+ Ensure data pipelines remain scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
+ Support near real-time updates across ontology and knowledge graph environments.
Data Governance, Quality & Lineage
+ Implement automated data quality controls and validation frameworks.
+ Support schema discovery and metadata catalog capabilities.
+ Capture and maintain end-to-end data lineage from source systems through graph and ontology representations.
+ Establish governance controls including:
+ IAM Policies
+ Encryption Standards
+ Metadata Tracking
+ Lineage Instrumentation
+ Partner with architecture and governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.
Ontology & AI Enablement
+ Support ontology mapping activities by providing:
+ Profiled Schemas
+ Data Dependency Maps
+ Sample Data Sets
+ Metadata Context
+ Deliver curated and well-profiled datasets supporting machine learning and entity-resolution initiatives.
+ Collaborate with Data Scientists and Applied AI teams to improve data quality and knowledge graph accuracy.
+ Enable graph-based AI use cases, entity matching, semantic search, and inference capabilities.
Monitoring, Reliability & Optimization
+ Monitor platform health, ingestion jobs, graph-processing workloads, and metadata services.
+ Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues and implement preventative solutions.
+ Optimize performance, scalability, and operational efficiency across the platform stack.
+ Manage cost optimization initiatives across cloud infrastructure and processing workloads.

+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
+ 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering.

+ Strong expertise in:
+ Python
+ SQL

+ BigQuery
+ Dataflow
+ Pub/Sub

As an Individual Contributor on the Data Studio team, you will play a key role in transforming raw customer data into structured, high-fidelity datasets that power model training, evaluation, and customer delivery. This role is deeply hands-on and sits at the intersection of product, research, and engineering. You will apply your mechanical engineering and manufacturing expertise to create data pipelines, labeling workflows, reference models, and quality checks that ensure the accuracy and reliability of our AI systems. Mechanical engineering or manufacturing design experience is essential; candidates without this background will not be considered.

### Key Responsibilities

* **1\. Data Creation, Processing & Quality**
* Ingest, clean, transform, and structure customer and internally generated engineering data for AI training and inference.
* Design and build high-quality mechanical components and assemblies in CAD to serve as authoritative ground truth for evaluating and training AI systems.
* Produce labeled datasets, reference designs, annotations, exploded views, sequences, and other engineering artifacts that encode real-world reasoning.
* Apply engineering judgment to define and assess output quality across datasets.
* Continuously refine standards for metadata, annotation, and model quality, maintaining a living “definition of quality” for ME datasets.

* **2\. Workflow & Tooling Contributions**
* Collaborate with Product Managers to shape tooling used for annotation, data correction, model-output review, and pipeline automation.
* Provide detailed feedback on tool usability, workflow efficiency, and automation opportunities.
* Help develop scalable, repeatable data processes that improve throughput and data consistency.

* **3\. Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with engineering and research teams to understand model data requirements, failure modes, and areas needing new data.
* Influence model behavior by supplying representative engineering examples and ground-truth mechanical designs.
* Partner with customer-facing teams to translate domain requirements, industry standards, and customer data schemas into actionable dataset specifications.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on mechanical engineering formats, CAD standards, manufacturing practices, and design artifacts.

* **4\. Domain Expertise & Reference Content Creation**
* Generate technical documentation, exploded views, sequences, and annotations that encode engineering reasoning into training data.
* Ensure that datasets reflect real-world constraints, DFM (Design for Manufacturing) considerations, material behavior, and industry best practices.
* Embed engineering reasoning into training data so that AI systems learn not just geometry or text, but engineering intent.

* **5\. Customer & Project Support**
* Work with customers to understand their data sources, schemas, formats, and quality expectations.
* Guide customers in preparing high-quality datasets, defining structured schemas, and improving data pipelines.
* Support delivery timelines by communicating progress clearly and surfacing risks or issues early.
* Review and work with external contractors, ensuring high-quality output and adherence to SOPs.

### Required Qualifications

* Strong domain expertise in mechanical engineering, manufacturing design, or industrial workflows.
* Hands-on experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, or Creo.
* Familiarity with annotation tools and illustration software (e.g., Creo Illustrate, Adobe Illustrator, Arbortext).
* Ability to interpret complex mechanical assemblies, technical drawings, GD&T, and engineering documentation.
* Experience creating artifacts like exploded views, work-step sequences, repair manuals, or manufacturing instructions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate domain workflows into structured data requirements.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with data operations, labeling workflows, ML data pipelines, or AI/ML data lifecycle (collection -> labeling -> QA -> training -> evaluation -> deployment).
* Experience in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments.
* Comfort with customer-facing discovery or solutioning.
